candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Given how simple the project is, I expect the review and stamp to be completed in 2 business days. Since this is a very simple change, I was hoping to have it stamped for \$100. Please let me know. Thanks

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Although the 36 pages may look daunting, you do not actually need to review all of them. I initially thought the same, but the work only involves reviewing the minor modifications identified in the word file. I am a mechanical PE for this change, and my scope was reduced to the attached file \(only the highlighted portion\). The situation is the same for electrical. If it works for you, let’s settle on \$150, and I will notify the client. Please advise.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Additionally, could you let me know whether you can support me with the attached project? Please provide your price and timeline for permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with an electrical PE stamp \(I will handle the Mechanical and Plumbing stamp\).

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Okay, I’ll ask the client about that. To confirm, this will include permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with all required load calculations \(T 24 is not needed, but HvAC sizing calculations are\), correct? Could you also provide your California electrical PE license number? The project should kick off soon \(within no more than two weeks\).

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Apologies for the delayed reply. You would create the drawings and stamp the electrical drawings \(I will stamp the mechanical drawings\). You would also perform whatever calculations are required to produce the drawings \(please let me know whether that is within your competence\). This includes Manual. J, Manual S,,Manual D as applicable.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I hope you’re doing well!

The client contacted me to ask whether you can stamp the changes without redlines, possibly by adding a letter describing the change you are approving. Would that be feasible? If so, I can send you the formal offer. Please advise.

Could you also resend the PE name and license number? I’m finding different information for license #: 16119 on the Nevada PE website.

Thanks,
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The .pdf file is a copy of the as built drawings, meaning those drawings show the conditions before this project introduced changes. The electrical revisions completed under this project are identified in the word file that you are reviewing and approving so the as built electrical drawings can be amended as part of this project.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Whichever option is easier for you, you may either stamp the word file and add a cover letter, or mark up the existing pdf with redlines and stamp it to indicate your concurrence with the changes made.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: I asked the client to send pictures of the changes so that you can use them to verify that the work was completed as specified in the word file eat.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],
I stopped during my travels and had an opportunity to review the letter. It looks good, but it is missing the PE stamp. Could you please sign it and return it to me?

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Thanks, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]. I believe the signature block still reads “engineer name “. It needs to be changed to the actual name.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: The date must also use the US format. It currently shows 18/07/2026, but it should read 07/18/2026.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I hope you’re doing well!

Thank you. We received the client’s electrical notes. The stamped note was good and the drawings were fine; he only wanted specific items called out. I included their request along with the information provided by the electrician. Could you please stamp these callouts? They are part of the original scope, just presented in greater detail.

Thanks

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Thank you for your response, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]. These callouts contain the same information you stamped in the letter. Rather than appearing as written statements, they are now presented as drawings. You can see that your letter specifies the heading for each callout, while the corresponding description is depicted in the drawing.

Could you please reconsider and stamp the original scope in drawing format? Addressing the city/client’s comments is part of the second milestone.
Thank you in advance for your support.
